_comment: Core classes only: everything else on Classroom (clubs, homeroom) is ignored. match = a distinctive, case-insensitive part of the Classroom class name (list them: collect.py --list-classes); course = vault folder.
_comment_college: college_classes are read only for college-application posts (college_posts.py → To-Do 🎓 College). Their own assignments (yearbook, senior events) are never tracked.
_comment_signin: Text found in the URL/HTML of your school's single-sign-on page; an expired session lands there. Google's own sign-in is always detected.
